spec.name: funding_mean_reversion
spec.thesis: Crypto funding rates are mean-reverting, and when they are high, it's a good time to buy because the market is likely over-leveraged and due for a correction

spec.name: low_volatility_harvest
spec.thesis: Index funds and other investors are forced to rebalance their portfolios, and low volatility assets tend to be oversold during periods of high market stress, providing an opportunity for mean reversion
